site.tagline: Building value across Kashmir through property, enterprise technology, agriculture, and strategic ventures.
site.heroTitle: Rooted in Kashmir. Building for the Future.
site.heroSubtitle: Kashmir Holdings is a family-led, multi-disciplinary enterprise connecting Kashmir's real estate, agricultural heritage, technology, and emerging business opportunities.
site.aboutTitle: A Family Enterprise Built Around Kashmir
site.aboutBody: Rooted in Srinagar, Kashmir Holdings is a multi-disciplinary family enterprise built around a simple vision: create sustainable value by combining local knowledge, trusted relationships, modern technology, and long-term thinking. Our businesses span prime real estate, family orchards, Kashmiri products, enterprise technology, business consulting, strategic investments, and new commercial ventures.
site.mission: To build trusted businesses that contribute to the economic growth of Kashmir while creating lasting value for our customers, partners, and communities.
site.vision: To become a trusted and diversified business group from Kashmir, connecting regional opportunity with modern enterprise.
site.serviceArea: Jammu & Kashmir, India and selected international markets
